watch.2: the case log at the police office, and the back alley's meter box after dark

lines: Your visit to the police office on {date} is in my ledger. Entry only. No conclusion attached.
You logged a wave at {place} on {date}. One sighting is an anecdote. Bring me a second night.
The audit stays open. That is not a delay. That is the method.

spot.line: A new tab on the records shelf, in square capitals: "OPEN. Do not close. S."
